name: Hard-Negative Dual-View Contrastive Bi-Encoder with Depth Deconfounding
summary: We train paired residual neural encoders with symmetric InfoNCE contrastive loss to retrieve an unseen cell's unsmoothed ATAC profile from its RNA counts alone. The ATAC encoder combines sparse TF-IDF peaks and promoter-and-distal gene activity while penalizing sequencing-depth shortcuts. Training uses binomial thinning, unsupervised inverse-cluster weighting, and an intra-cluster hard-negative batch curriculum fitted strictly on inner-training cells. Benchmarking on held-out queries (and an expanded 4,946-cell distractor pool) against required floors, linear CCA, and split-half ceilings determines whether retrieval exceeds cluster resolution.
analysis_unit: Individual cell (single nucleus with co-measured RNA and ATAC in development splits)
preprocessing: Partition the 7,288 paired development cells once by cell ID into disjoint inner_train (4,372), inner_val (1,094), and outer_test (1,822) splits; assert zero cell-ID overlap across splits and against the 3,124 held-out ATAC-only distractor cells.

Restrict RNA counts to the 11,282 in-scope genes; apply per-cell library-size normalization (CP10k) and log1p, then standardize per gene using mean and standard deviation fitted strictly on inner_train.
Select the top 40,000 accessible ATAC peaks strictly on inner_train; compute sparse TF-IDF using inner_train IDF weights followed by per-cell L2 normalization.

Aggregate ATAC counts into promoter_and_distal gene_activity over the 11,282 in-scope genes via the 87,029 peak-gene links, normalize by per-cell ATAC depth, apply log1p, and standardize using inner_train statistics.

Standardize per-cell log RNA UMI depth and log ATAC fragment depth using inner_train statistics solely for training-time depth-orthogonality regularization, depth-leakage auditing, and the Floor 1 comparator.

Fit unsupervised k=30 k-means on concatenated inner_train RNA PCA(50) and ATAC LSI(50) strictly within inner_train to compute inverse-square-root cluster sample weights and intra-cluster hard-negative neighborhoods without touching WNN annotations.

training.batch_curriculum: epochs 1-25 uniform random inner_train mini-batches; epochs 26-120 50% intra-cluster hard-negative batches sampled from inner_train k=30 k-means neighborhoods
training.sample_weighting: unsupervised inner_train inverse-square-root k=30 cluster frequency weights in symmetric InfoNCE loss
training.input_augmentation: per-epoch stochastic binomial count thinning (keep probability Uniform(0.7, 1.0)) on raw inner_train RNA and ATAC counts before per-cell normalization, plus 15% input feature dropout
training.convergence_audit: record per-epoch train/inner_val InfoNCE loss, learned temperature, depth-embedding correlation, and inner_val MRR; emit loss curves and verify validation MRR plateau before outer_test evaluation

validation.scoring_rule: independent single-query cosine similarity on unsmoothed outer_test profiles with deterministic mid-ranks for ties; evaluate 3-seed L2-normalized embedding ensemble and audit single-seed spread on inner_val
comparators_on_identical_units: Floor 1 (log ATAC fragment depth matched to query log RNA UMI depth)
Simple linear reference (inner_train cca_latent on RNA PCA and ATAC LSI)
Noise-ceiling ruler (binomial-thinning unimodal split-half self-retrieval on outer_test)
validation.statistical_inference: paired nonparametric bootstrap (2,000 resamples over outer_test query cells) 95% CIs for MRR and all comparator deltas on both the 1,822 paired pool and 4,946 distractor-expanded pool; post-hoc WNN-stratified MRR and recall@1 across 19 cell types with Benjamini-Hochberg 5% FDR

allowed_conclusions: Map paired-bootstrap 95% CIs on outer_test strictly to the four objective conclusion options: claim single-cell resolution only if Recall@1 is substantial and MRR significantly exceeds Floors 0-3 and linear CCA while approaching the split-half ceiling; claim partial sub-cluster resolution if MRR significantly beats Floors 0-3 (and linear CCA for nonlinear superiority) without reliable top-1 recovery; claim cell-type resolution only if MRR beats Floors 0-1 but not Floor 3; otherwise conclude no biological retrieval. Scope is restricted to unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs from this single healthy donor at this sequencing depth and pool size.
rationale: Linear SVD discards non-linear enhancer combinations and remains vulnerable to sequencing-depth shortcuts (D5). Pairing sparse peaks with cis-linked gene activity under binomial thinning counteracts extreme sparsity (D1). Unsupervised inverse-cluster weights and intra-cluster hard negatives address rare populations (D2) and sub-cluster retrieval beyond coarse centroids (D6).
